Its `/pair"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"` bootstrap response is intentionally available to any caller on that loopback port so an unpacked e"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"xtension can pair without reading the host token file; any local process or installed extension that"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" can reach the port is therefore trusted with browser control. Keep the Bridge port off network prox"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ies. Host-launched instances expose a non-secret instance id, launcher label and capability list; an"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"y paired DSH or Pi Host in the same local-user control domain may request a cooperative restart when"},{"id":"p13s7","text":" the Bridge exposes `capabilities.localUserRestart: true` and has no pending browser request. The in"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"stance id prevents stale restart races, and a restart lock serializes concurrent requests. Unknown l"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"egacy Bridges remain untouched when they do not expose the local-user capability.
